page: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a high-density GPU server instance within the Cloud GPU family, engineered primarily for accelerated machine learning and large model inference workloads. The hardware platform is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9124 processor delivering 30 dedicated physical cores clocked at 2.75 GHz without multithreading overhead. System resources include 180 GB of system memory, providing 6 GB of RAM per dedicated core, alongside 400 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth interface of 16 Gbps.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by two NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L40S graphics processors equipped with an aggregate 96 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM (48 GB per card). In benchmark testing, this dual-accelerator configuration demonstrates top-tier LLM inference processing. For small 135M parameter models, it hits 13,577.25 tokens per second in prompt processing and 462.43 tokens per second in text generation. For 70B parameter models, prompt evaluation reaches 899.34 tokens per second with generation rates of 15.56 tokens per second, positioning the instance in the top 10% bracket for inference tasks.

General-purpose compute performance remains solid, supported by instruction extensions including AVX-512, VNNI, and bfloat16. The server achieved strong multi-core marks in stress-ng (89,985.55) and PassMark CPU tests (57,957.13), alongside elevated memory caching benchmarks and 62.24 million Redis SET operations per second. While uncached large-block RAM throughput settles in average percentiles, raw core allocation and hardware instruction efficiency remain consistent.

Because public IPv4 networking requires separate configuration and local storage capacity is modest at 400 GB, storage-heavy architectures will necessitate external volumes. However, by coupling dedicated CPU cores with dual L40S GPUs, the server offers high operational efficiency for LLM serving, generative AI pipelines, complex rendering, and batch inference workflows.
description: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a high-performance GPU server built for intensive compute and deep learning workloads. Driven by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor, the system provides 30 dedicated x86_64 physical cores at 2.75 GHz, 180 GB of system RAM, 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and a 16 Gbps network interface. Acceleration is delivered through dual NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L40S GPUs delivering 96 GB of combined VRAM. In benchmark suites, the server ranks in the top decile for large language model inference across 7B and 70B parameter architectures, supported by hardware AVX-512 extensions and high multi-core throughput in stress-ng and PassMark benchmarks. Redis SET operations exceed 62 million operations per second, confirming strong handling of distributed in-memory data structures. The configuration represents a dense computational profile optimized for enterprise AI inference, machine learning pipelines, and intensive batch rendering.
